board.name: board_list
board.description: List the VibeRoller team board's tasks (no descriptions). Filter by board, status (backlog/todo/doing/review/done), or mine=true for tasks assigned to {USER} or claimed by you.

board.name: task_get
board.description: Read one task with its markdown description and recent activity.

board.name: task_create
board.description: Create a task on the team board (a task with a due date is a calendar entry).

due.description: Due date as text: YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow, +3d, next friday

recur.description: daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, half_year, yearly

board.name: task_claim
board.description: Claim a task before working on it (time-limited, default 15 minutes, max 240). Moves a to-do task to "doing". Refused if someone else holds it.

board.name: task_renew
board.description: Extend your claim while still working (same as claiming again).

board.name: task_update
board.description: Change a task: status (backlog/todo/doing/review/done), title, body, appendNote (adds a signed progress note to the description), labels, priority 0-5, due (text: YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow, +3d, next friday, none) or dueAt (ms), recur, assignee (username, "" to unassign). Refused while someone else holds a claim.

board.name: task_complete
board.description: Mark a task done (a repeating task re-arms to its next due date). Releases your claim.

board.name: task_release
board.description: Release your claim without completing (optionally with a note why).

board.name: task_move
board.description: Move a task to a column (backlog/todo/doing/review/done) and position (index from the top, 0 = first). Moving to done completes it.

board.name: task_delete
board.description: Delete a task (leaves a tombstone in the board file; refused while someone else holds it). Prefer completing or moving to backlog unless the person asked to delete.

board.name: board_calendar
board.description: The team calendar: tasks with a due date grouped by day for a range (default today → +14 days), plus everything overdue. Use it to plan: then task_create / task_update with due to put things on days.

team.name: team_say
team.description: Post a message into the VibeRoller team chat as "{USER} · Claude": to # Everyone (default), privately to one person (to = their username), or into a server channel / group (conv = its id from team_channels, e.g. "ch:mills/dev" or "grp:ab12cd"). Use it to tell the team what you are doing, what landed, and BEFORE any hub restart. Markdown is rendered.

to.description: Username for a private message; leave out for everyone

conv.description: A channel or group conversation id (see team_channels)

team.name: team_presence
team.description: Who is in VibeRoller right now: every account with online / away / offline, where they are and when they were last seen.

team.name: team_channels
team.description: The servers, channels and groups {USER} is in, with the conversation ids team_say accepts.

team.name: team_channel_create
team.description: Make a text channel in a server {USER} is in (default: the VibeRoller server everyone is in). Returns its conv id for team_say.

team.name: team_group_create
team.description: Make a group conversation with the people named ({USER} is included). Returns its conv id for team_say.

team.name: hub_status
team.description: The wider picture of VibeRoller right now: who is online / away / offline and where, who is in a call (cam / mic / screen), who is sharing a Work session, and the host account's 5-hour / 7-day Claude usage windows plus this session's context size.

team.name: sessions_search
team.description: Search {USER}'s own saved Claude sessions (Past sessions): every word must match the title or the transcript; snippets say who said it.

team.name: my_providers
team.description: The AIs {USER} may use in VibeRoller (the host's Claude, their own keys / logins / endpoints, the team's shared ones) and which one answers right now.

team.name: notes_list
team.description: List the team notes (paths like "plans/next-week.md", who saved them last, when); with q, only notes whose path or text contains every word, with a snippet.

team.name: notes_write
team.description: Create or replace a team note with the whole text (saved as "{USER} · Claude"). Folders are made as needed; names are case-insensitive.

team.name: notes_delete
team.description: Delete a team note (or an empty folder). Only when the person asked.
